'''Butter-basted land shrimp''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] dish. The catering company [[Estimable Epicures]] served [[Butter/Legends|butter]]-basted [[land shrimp]] at a reception hosted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Ritinki]] and [[Vop]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.<ref name="J15" />

==Behind the scenes==
Butter-basted land shrimp first appeared in ''[[The Great Herdship Heist]]'', a short story written by [[Daniel Wallace]], illustrated by [[Will Warren]], and published in [[November]] [[1997]] in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15]].<ref name="J15" />
